SERVICES

Understanding the features and boundaries of a tract of land is essential in how that parcel of property is handled. Whether for mortgages or development, preservation and beyond, land surveying is critical and we’re here to help. We offer a number of different surveying capabilities to our clients based on their unique needs, including:

Facility Line Survey

A facility line or marine survey is a survey depicting the permitted area extending into State Waters that a home owner can effectively build a dock.

Read More

Lot Survey

“Lot Survey” may also be known as a “Closing Survey” or “Mortgage Survey” typically done prior to the closing.

Read More

Topographic Survey

A topographic survey is the delineation of horizontal and/or vertical locations of existing natural or man-made features of a portion of the earth’s surface, subsurface or airspace

Read More

Subdivision

A subdivision is a parcel of land divided from a larger area.

Read More

Site Plan

A site plan is an architectural plan, landscape architecture document, and a detailed engineering drawing of proposed improvements to a given lot.

Read More

Property Survey

A boundary survey is a way to formally define the boundaries of a property.

Read More

QUALITY GUARANTEE

We strive to ensure first-class service along every step of the surveying process.

We have built an experienced, hard-working team that is committed to delivering a high-quality service to our customers and making every project we take on a successful one.
